stem:
Read the following sentence from paragraph 7.

The solution was tossed my way the following Monday when I stopped at Thompson's after school to look at the pencils.

What can the reader conclude about the narrator from this sentence?

options.label: F
options.text: He will find the money he needs at the drugstore that day.

options.label: G
options.text: He will get the money he needs in an unexpected way.

options.label: H
options.text: He will work at the drugstore after school each day to earn money.

options.label: J
options.text: He will collect money at school before going to the drugstore.

visual_elements: The solution was tossed my way the following Monday when I stopped at Thompson's after school to look at the pencils.
